news.title: Gainsight Unveils Value-Based Pricing and AI-Native Retention Services -
Gainsight launches AI-native Atlas managing $75M ARR and new value-based pricing for customer retention.

bullets: Own the customer engagement from discovery through full scope delivery.
Define and document implementation requirements for each account, validated against the customer's real data and workflows.
Own resolution of blockers across support, engineering, and the customer's IT.
Lead the technical implementation of Atlas agents inside customer tenants: data mapping across objects, fields, and tokens, connector configuration, and authentication setup…
Support the rollout of AI agents alongside an AI native services team leveraging both agentic and human engagement.
